review_candidates.title: Technology Operations Associate
review_candidates.description_excerpt: About This Role We are seeking a Technology Operations Associate to deliver exceptional technology support and help maintain operational stability across the organization. This role serves as a frontline technical resource responsible for resolving technology issues, supporting business-critical applications, and ensuring a high-quality customer experience through effective troubleshooting, incident ownership, and operational excellence. In This Role, You Will Serve as the first point of contact
eligibility_evidence: In This Role, You Will Serve as the first point of contact for technology support via phone, chat, and ticketing systems Deliver exceptional customer service with empathy, professionalism, and a sense of urgency Troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, mobile devices, VDI, Cloud PC, VPN, MFA, Active Dir

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: In This Role, You Will Serve as the first point of contact for technology support via phone, chat, and ticketing systems Deliver exceptional customer service with empathy, professionalism, and a sense of urgency Troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, mobile devices, VDI, Cloud PC, VPN, MFA, Active Directory, and remote access technologies Support business-critical applications, user access, and account-related requests Analyze incidents, identify root causes, and drive timely resolution Take ownership of incidents from initial contact through resolution or escalation Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in ServiceNow Escalate complex issues while ensuring effective communication and follow-up Monitor and respond to operational issues, service disruptions, and technology incidents Maintain compliance with security, risk, and access management standards Identify process
